## 2.3 Geocoding HDB resale data

### Importing HDB data

```{r}
HDBresale <- read_csv(
  "data/rawdata/HDBresale.csv") %>%
  filter(flat_type == "4 Room") %>%
  filter(month >= "2025-01" & month < "2025-10")

HDBresale$street_name <- gsub("ST\\.", "SAINT", HDBresale$street_name)

glimpse(HDBresale)
```
